summary.intent: Finish renaming the remaining STAGING_-prefixed CI/CD variables and secrets (including HOST and USER) to unprefixed names across GitHub Actions workflows.
summary.outcome: Verified how the remaining STAGING_ variables were consumed, copied the three remaining variables to unprefixed names, updated workflow references and docs, and committed the second rename.

repo: GitHub Actions variables in this repo are consumed only via inline ${{ vars.X }} expressions passed directly into action inputs, never through a workflow-level env: block — so renaming vars.STAGING_HOST/USER to bare HOST/USER carries no risk of shadowing shell environment variables.
deploy-landing workflow has environment-specific scoping that needed to be checked before renaming variables to avoid breaking per-environment variable resolution.
workflow: When renaming CI variables, first grep all usages to confirm whether they pass through an env: block (risk of shell shadowing) versus only inline into action inputs (safe) before deciding on unprefixed names like HOST/USER.
